sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) There shall be freedom of opinion, debate and proceedings in the National Assembly, and that freedom shall not be breached or questioned by any organ in the United Republic, or in any court or elsewhere outside the National Assembly. (2) Subject to this Constitution or the provisions of any other relevant law, no Member of Parliament shall be prosecuted or subjected to civil proceedings in a court on account of anything said or done by him in the National Assembly or brought by him before the National Assembly by way of petition, Bill, motion or otherwise.
